slot_assignment.name: slot_assignment
slot_assignment.value:
("itervane"."execution_slot"."task_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."execution_slot"."run_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."execution_slot"."worker_id" IS NULL)
  OR ("itervane"."execution_slot"."task_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."execution_slot"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."execution_slot"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL)

formal_audit_input_binding.name: formal_audit_input_binding
formal_audit_input_binding.value:
("itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."prepared_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"->>'taskId' = "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."task_id"::text AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"#>>'{inspection,requestId}' = "itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."inspection_request_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_audit_inputs"."document"::text) <= 65536) IS TRUE

formal_audit_result_binding.name: formal_audit_result_binding
formal_audit_result_binding.value:
("itervane"."formal_audit_results"."finalized_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."input_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."run_id"::text
  AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."document"->>'inputSha256' = "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."input_sha256" AND "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."document"->>'checkpointId' = "itervane"."formal_audit_results"."checkpoint_id"
  AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_audit_results"."document"::text) <= 98304) IS TRUE

formal_repair_attempt_state.name: formal_repair_attempt_state
formal_repair_attempt_state.value:
(
    ("itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."state" = 'reserved' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_fence" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_worker_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."state" IN ('closed', 'uncertain', 'recorded') AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_fence" >= "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."fence"
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_worker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)) IS TRUE

formal_repair_attempt_receipt.name: formal_repair_attempt_receipt
formal_repair_attempt_receipt.value:
(
    ("itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."state" <> 'recorded' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."state" = 'recorded' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_fence" = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."fence" AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."settled_worker_id" = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."worker_id"
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"::text) <= 32768
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->>'kind' = 'repair_receipt' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->'cleanupConfirmed' = 'true'::jsonb
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->'sessionVerified' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->>'originSha256' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."origin_sha256"
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->>'imageSha256' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."image_sha256"
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,requestId}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."request_id"::text AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,operationId}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."operation_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,workspaceSha256}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."workspace_sha256" AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,fence}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."fence"::text
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"->>'domainId' = "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{snapshot,runId}'
      AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,offline}' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."formal_repair_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,readOnly}' = 'true'::jsonb)
  ) IS TRUE

formal_repair_input_binding.name: formal_repair_input_binding
formal_repair_input_binding.value:
("itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."prepared_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."run_id"::text
  AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_repair_inputs"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

formal_repair_operation_command.name: formal_repair_operation_command
formal_repair_operation_command.value:
("itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."prepared_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."call_key_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."input_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."command") BETWEEN 1 AND 2097152
    AND "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."command_sha256" = encode(sha256(convert_to("itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."command", 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    AND "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."command"::jsonb#>>'{workspace,operationId}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."operation_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."command"::jsonb#>>'{workspace,repairInputSha256}' = "itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."input_sha256"
    AND jsonb_typeof("itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."finding_ids") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("itervane"."formal_repair_operations"."finding_ids") BETWEEN 1 AND 32) IS TRUE

formal_repair_result_binding.name: formal_repair_result_binding
formal_repair_result_binding.value:
("itervane"."formal_repair_results"."finalized_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."input_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."run_id"::text
  AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'inputSha256' = "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."input_sha256" AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'checkpointId' = "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."checkpoint_id"
  AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->'releaseEligible' = 'false'::jsonb AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"::text) <= 16384
  AND (("itervane"."formal_repair_results"."request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'status' = 'candidate_ready' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'reason' = 'repair_complete'
      AND jsonb_typeof("itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->'candidate') = 'object')
    OR ("itervane"."formal_repair_results"."request_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->>'status' = 'requires_human' AND "itervane"."formal_repair_results"."document"->'candidate' = 'null'::jsonb))) IS TRUE

formal_rescan_attempt_state.name: formal_rescan_attempt_state
formal_rescan_attempt_state.value:
(("itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."state" = 'reserved' AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_fence" IS NULL
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_worker_id" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_at" IS NULL) OR ("itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."state" IN ('closed', 'uncertain', 'recorded')
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_fence" >= "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."fence" AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_worker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)) IS TRUE

formal_rescan_attempt_receipt.name: formal_rescan_attempt_receipt
formal_rescan_attempt_receipt.value:
(("itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."state" <> 'recorded' AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt_sha256" IS NULL AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt" IS NULL) OR (
    "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."state" = 'recorded' AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_fence" = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."fence" AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."settled_worker_id" = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."worker_id"
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"::text) <= 9437184
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->>'kind' = 'verification_receipt' AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->'cleanupConfirmed' = 'true'::jsonb
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->'sessionVerified' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->>'originSha256' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."origin_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->>'imageSha256' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."image_sha256" AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"->>'domainId' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{snapshot,runId}'
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,requestId}' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."request_id"::text AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,runId}' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,fence}' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."fence"::text AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,workspaceSha256}' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."workspace_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,verificationInputSha256}' = "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."input_sha256"
    AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,offline}' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."formal_rescan_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,readOnly}' = 'true'::jsonb)) IS TRUE

formal_verification_input_binding.name: formal_verification_input_binding
formal_verification_input_binding.value:
("itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."prepared_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."run_id"::text
  AND octet_length("itervane"."formal_verification_inputs"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

inspection_attempt_workspace_binding.name: inspection_attempt_workspace_binding
inspection_attempt_workspace_binding.value:
"itervane"."inspection_attempts"."workspace_sha256" IS NULL OR (
    "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."workspace_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."state" <> 'recorded'
    OR ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,workspaceSha256}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."workspace_sha256") IS TRUE))

inspection_attempt_state.name: inspection_attempt_state
inspection_attempt_state.value:
(
    ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."state" = 'reserved' AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."settled_fence" IS NULL AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."settled_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."state" IN ('closed', 'uncertain', 'recorded') AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."settled_fence" >= "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."fence" AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL)
  ) IS TRUE

inspection_attempt_receipt_binding.name: inspection_attempt_receipt_binding
inspection_attempt_receipt_binding.value:
(
    ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."state" <> 'recorded' AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt" IS NULL AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt_sha256" IS NULL)
    OR ("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."state" = 'recorded' AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."settled_fence" = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."fence" AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND octet_length("itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"::text) <= 4202496
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->>'kind' = 'receipt' AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->'cleanupConfirmed' = 'true'::jsonb
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->'sessionVerified' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->>'originSha256' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."origin_sha256"
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->>'imageSha256' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."image_sha256"
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,requestId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."request_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,taskId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."task_id"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,runId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."run_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,projectId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,repositoryId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."repository_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,commit}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."commit" AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,planSha256}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."plan_sha256"
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,fence}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."fence"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{scope,generation}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."generation"::text
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"->>'domainId' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{snapshot,runId}'
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{snapshot,repositoryId}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."repository_id"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>>'{snapshot,commit}' = "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."commit"
      AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,offline}' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."inspection_attempts"."receipt"#>'{snapshot,readOnly}' = 'true'::jsonb)
  ) IS TRUE

inspection_plan_binding.name: inspection_plan_binding
inspection_plan_binding.value:
("itervane"."inspection_plans"."prepared_fence" > 0 AND "itervane"."inspection_plans"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."inspection_plans"."document"->>'taskId' = "itervane"."inspection_plans"."task_id"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_plans"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."inspection_plans"."run_id"::text AND "itervane"."inspection_plans"."document"->>'version' = '1') IS TRUE

preaudit_document_binding.name: preaudit_document_binding
preaudit_document_binding.value:
("itervane"."preaudits"."request_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "itervane"."preaudits"."report_sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'id' = "itervane"."preaudits"."id"::text AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."preaudits"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"->>'requestedBy' = "itervane"."preaudits"."requested_by"::text
  AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"#>>'{evaluation,formalScan}' = 'false' AND "itervane"."preaudits"."document"#>>'{evaluation,releaseEligible}' = 'false'
  AND octet_length("itervane"."preaudits"."document"::text) <= 65536) IS TRUE

release_candidate_binding.name: release_candidate_binding
release_candidate_binding.value:
("itervane"."release_candidates"."evidence_version" > 0 AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."fingerprint" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'version' = '1' AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'origin' = 'trusted_fixture'
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->'releaseEligible' = 'false'::jsonb
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'evidenceVersion' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."evidence_version"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'projectId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."project_id"::text AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'taskId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."task_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"->>'runId' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."run_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"#>>'{target,applicationId}' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."application_id"::text
    AND "itervane"."release_candidates"."document"#>>'{target,environmentId}' = "itervane"."release_candidates"."environment_id"::text
    AND octet_length("itervane"."release_candidates"."document"::text) <= 8192) IS TRUE

release_operation_observation.name: release_operation_observation
release_operation_observation.value:
(
    ("itervane"."release_operations"."state" <> 'verified_fixture' AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation" IS NULL) OR
    ("itervane"."release_operations"."state" = 'verified_fixture' AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'origin' = 'trusted_fixture'
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'operationId' = "itervane"."release_operations"."id"::text
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->>'environmentId' = "itervane"."release_operations"."environment_id"::text
      AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->'healthy' = 'true'::jsonb AND "itervane"."release_operations"."observation"->'accessProtected' = 'true'::jsonb
      AND octet_length("itervane"."release_operations"."observation"::text) <= 4096)
  ) IS TRUE

event_actor_kind.name: event_actor_kind
event_actor_kind.value: ("itervane"."task_events"."actor_kind" = 'principal' AND "itervane"."task_events"."worker_id" IS NULL) OR ("itervane"."task_events"."actor_kind" = 'worker' AND "itervane"."task_events"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL)
